This combination should be avoided, or alternative drugs should be considered. The additive immune system effects of etrasimod in combination with antineoplastic, immune-modulating, or non-corticosteroid immunosuppressive therapies have not been studied. Co-administration should be avoided during and in the weeks following etrasimod administration. 2. The risk of additive heart rate reduction when initiating beta-blocker therapy with stable etrasimod treatment or using other heart rate-reducing drugs is unknown. 5.
